info.headline: Notify NYC - 2026 TCS New York City Marathon - 11/1 (NYC)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-29-2026 at 10:01 AM.
As part of the 2026 TCS NYC Marathon, numerous street and bridge closures will be in effect citywide on Sunday, 11/1, at the discretion of the NYPD. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time.
In addition, the upper level of the Verrazzano Bridge will be closed at 11:00 PM on 10/31 and the lower level will be closed at 7:00 AM on 11/1. Both levels will be reopened at approximately 4:00 PM on 11/1.
Text NYCMARATHON to 692-692 for event-related updates. For Spanish, text MARATHONESP.
For more information, please visit: https://www.nyrr.org/tcsnycmarathon
